items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Thad Jones material and Oliver Nelson material

ctx.x: Do you consider yourself a big band drummer?

Yeah. I mean actually I did it, I mean that was part of my experience and training coming up, and a lot of the gigs we did, casuals or club dates, had to do with big bands, so that was a skill that was valuable. And I sort of spent some time at it. And then I didn’t do it for a long time, there weren’t any gigs and I stopped making rehearsal bands and stuff like that. And then this club Pearl’s where I work has a Monday Night Big Band and I used to sub in that once in a while. And now I’m kind of doing it on a…
Well who were the people that influenced you, drummers, along the way?
